rationale: PINS Matrix 1b docstring payloads for scala: ScalaDoc (block_comment starting /**) lands on BOTH class and method symbols. Previously scala symbols carried NO comments at all - scala grammar names doc comments block_comment, unlike kotlin's multiline_comment.
